narration: In month {fork_month}, with a new job and a little saved from before, you needed somewhere to live and took {real_choice}. The ghost took {ghost_choice}, and {first_bar_apart} was the first score to part, in month {first_bar_apart_month}. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}.
